summary: Event-Driven Ansible has an API and WebSocket service and an EventStream service, separate Gunicorn deployments for /api/eda and /api/eda-event-stream that must be scaled independently on OpenShift; on VM and container installs both scale together by adding hybrid nodes.
questions: How do I scale Event-Driven Ansible?
Are EDA API and event stream services separate?
How do I scale EDA on VM-based installs?
